title: Test-quality enforced in the reviewer (extends CAM-56 Layer B): anti-mock + per-test discipline + flaky
description: Extends the CAM-56 reviewer Layer B with codified test-quality rules cam learned empirically but never wrote down. (1) Anti-mock as a citable rubric line (warren CONSTITUTION Art. IV verbatim: 'a test that asserts a mock was called is documentation, not verification'); the reviewer FAILs a story that introduces new mock/fake/spy helpers or tests that skip real-dependency setup; codifies the CAM-55 fakes-lie lesson. (2) Adversarial-cases mandate: tests must cover malformed input, boundary values, and 'the case that broke last time', not happy-path only. (3) Per-test discipline checklist: behavior-named tests, one concept per test, async via a waitForCondition helper NOT a fixed setTimeout (anti-flake; this is the flaky_test_detection rubric gap and matches the reviewer suggestion about the hardcoded sleeps in tmux-introspect.test.ts), and a success/error/edge triad per feature. Written as reviewer-rubric items + a short AGENTS/CLAUDE convention ('real I/O, no mocks, mkdtemp, document why if you must mock'). Source: warren docs/CONSTITUTION.md Art. IV; kotadb testing_expert_review.md + testing_expert_plan.md; sapling/canopy/mulch/plot/seeds CONTRIBUTING 'no mocks' rule.
